fixes.what: Atropatene is drawn as direct Parthian land from -148 to 224 with no gain or vassal_start in the ledger (only contest_start -148 and contest_end -147), and it overlaps the existing atropatene dossier, which keeps Atropatene as its own autonomous state -148..225.
fixes.why: Mithridates I page: 'conquering Media and Atropatene in 148/7 BC'. The atropatene dossier's keyframe atropatene_-148 (-148..225, adjust) reads 'an autonomous state, frequently a vassal of the Parthian Empire'. Gazetteer test: 317 of the 496 Atropatene cells are in every Parthian outline from -126 to 215 (495 at -91, 166 at -77). The Parthian ledger still loses Atropatene to Armenia at -87 (/ledger/30) and contests it with Rome in -36 (/ledger/44), so it treats as its own land something it never gains.
fixes.fix: Add '-147 vassal_start atropatene' (region {"region": "Atropatene"}, confidence 2, source Mithridates I page) and a matching vassal_end (at -87 to Armenia with a later restart, and finally 224). Remove Atropatene from the -148 correction and subtract {"cliopatria": "Atropatene", "year": -170} from the Parthian keyframes -148..224 so that it gets the vassal tint. Or, if it stays direct, add a gain and agree with the atropatene author, who would then have to give up the land.
